comment: FIRING GAPS (embrasures) in the parapet of overwatch roofs (designer 2026-11-19, T-05 diagnosis on L_Gen_Depot_X4: the roof parapet is 95 cm, a sniper fires kneeling with the muzzle 85 cm over the floor and cannot fire over it). A gap is a span cut out of the parapet and refilled with a LOW SILL a kneeling muzzle clears; the overwatch spots (chokepoints.json threats.overwatch) stand at the roof rim behind those gaps. Tools/TrainingGround/src/levelgen/firingGaps.ts planFiringGaps reads this file and writes the layout's top-level `firing_gaps` (NOT inside buildings: geometryHash hashes the buildings); Scripts/Editor/build_levelgen_map.py cuts the parapet and spawns the sill piece from each gap entry (no numbers of its own); the tactical file lists the gaps and links every overwatch spot to its gap. Every number is here, nothing is hard-coded.
enabled_comment: false = no gaps are planned (withFiringGaps returns the layout unchanged, the builder cuts nothing extra).
sill_cm_comment: The gap's sill height over the roof floor, cm. A kneeling muzzle (85 cm over the floor) clears it; the parapet itself (95 cm) does not.
width_cm_comment: The gap's width along the parapet, cm: one man.
spacing_m_comment: The least centre-to-centre distance between two gaps on one parapet, m (also the exclusion zone round a spot gap for the extra gaps).
corner_clear_m_comment: A gap's edge keeps this far from either end of its parapet, m (the corner post stays solid).
max_per_side_comment: At most this many gaps on one parapet (spot gaps count).
max_per_roof_comment: At most this many gaps on one roof (spot gaps first, then the street-facing sides in the order N, S, W, E).
stand_inset_cm_comment: The shooter's stand point lies this far inside the parapet line behind the gap centre, cm (same idea as the window stand point, tacticalMap.ts WINDOW_STAND_INSET_CM).
street_probe_m_comment: A parapet FACES THE STREET when the point this far out from its midpoint (along the outward normal) is inside the map bounds and outside every other building's footprint, m.
ladder_clear_cm_comment: No gap within this of a ladder top or an external stair top arriving on that parapet's roof, cm (the climber steps off there; the builder already cuts that span).
roles_comment: A roof gets gaps when its building's role is listed here (GenBuilding.role, BUILDING_GENERATOR.md roles) or the analysis lists it in overwatchRoofs. It must also be a walkable roof with parapets.
